releaseNotes: Bulk mode: fix phone-number extraction (Maps now exposes phones via aria-label on call buttons / place links — text-only regex was missing them). Add 'Send All to CRM' on the Live Results tab: classifies every un-synced lead (new vs add-phone-to-existing vs already-in-CRM), applies one lead_category + assignee to the batch, sends serially with live progress and per-row status updates. Website link now skips google.com hosts so we don't capture search/maps URLs as the business website.
